Container.Name: spaces
Container.Overview:
Self-hosted deal management for angel and private-capital investing. Pinned to the published image ghcr.io/anishxbadri/spaces:0.1.0 (never latest); upgrading is changing that tag on purpose, after a backup.
Needs the spaces-postgres container from the same template set (pgvector/pgvector:pg17 — the migrations need pgvector 0.8 or newer; a plain Postgres fails at the first migration). Set DATABASE_URL to it and APP_URL to the address you open in the browser: Unraid assigns no domain, so this is http://your-unraid-ip:3000 on a LAN, or https://your-domain once a reverse proxy sits in front (the app never terminates TLS, and cookies are Secure only when APP_URL says https).
The Data path holds blobs and the auto-generated secret.key. Lose `./data/secret.key` and every stored credential is unrecoverable. (On Unraid, ./data is the Data path, mounted at /data.) Back it up together with the database.
First run: the setup token is printed to this container's log (Docker → spaces → Logs): `[setup] First-run setup token: …`. Open the WebUI at /setup and paste it. Local embeddings through Ollama are opt-in and need a container of their own.
Container.Requires: spaces-postgres (deploy/unraid/spaces-postgres.xml), running, with the password you set there in DATABASE_URL below.

Config.Name: WebUI port
Config.Description: The port the app listens on. APP_URL must name the same port.

Config.Name: Data
Config.Description: Blobs and secret.key. The container repairs the ownership of this path itself on every start.

Config.Name: DATABASE_URL
Config.Description: The spaces-postgres container: postgresql://spaces:<its POSTGRES_PASSWORD>@<your Unraid IP>:<its host port>/spaces

Config.Name: APP_URL
Config.Description: Scheme and host the browser uses to reach Spaces: http://<your Unraid IP>:3000 on a LAN, https://<domain> behind a reverse proxy.

Config.Name: MASTER_KEY
Config.Description: Optional. Leave empty and the key is generated into the Data path as secret.key on first start.
